letter.title: Hey Mottu!❤️
content: Thank you for coming into my life. ur enter made my life more lazy🤣

Our journey started in a boarding gate😂 randomly seeing a family.. a couple with their new born child travelling somewhere. seeing them i asked u when we travel like this with our baby🤣 do u remember??
We were not friends nor we spend time together nor I was in ur shift🤷🏻‍♀️ we used see each other once or twice in a month.still I don’t know y I asked u like tht.
Again on random day…random call. I know i was tipsy nd i said I LOVE YOU. Next day calling up nd saying it’s slip of tongue sorry🤣 then after 1 hour saying come let’s date❤️

Everything took just seconds. still figuring out how I fell for you. In a blink we were married. Getting married at 22 was never in my plans, and the fact that it’s a love marriage makes it even more unexpected.
There’s saying everything happens for good. And it’s true. I still believe god and Amma team up together and send me the most amazing gift from heaven.
After motta, Arun chettan, subhzz nd malu ur the one makes everything right in my life and I feel safe inside ur arms.
The love for u will be deeper each day. Thank you for everything wht ur doing for me and I love you lot❤️
Come home early let’s go for valentine date😜
